This '''alien race''' had green skin. [[Ran Deezy/Legends|Ran Deezy]], a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], was a member of the [[Species/Legends|species]]. Deezy was present in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the galactic capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] for a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] transmission from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
